barriers.reason: The patient has no one to watch the 4-month-old during a weekday 9:00 AM downtown visit; her sister works mornings, so she cannot bring the infant and sit for two hours.
The referral is to the main hospital campus at 9:00 AM, which is not the same easy Roosevelt bus trip to the clinic, and doing it with an infant makes the trip impractical as written.

alternatives.text: Ask the allergy/immunology unit for a later chair time or a different weekday that works without the infant, and confirm whether the infant can accompany the visit or if telehealth is an option.

barriers.reason: Mold remediation depends on the landlord, who has ignored two requests and only offered to paint over the bathroom mold, so the patient cannot reliably reduce this trigger herself.

alternatives.text: Provide the landlord letter (already planned), and refer the patient to local housing/code enforcement or legal aid to compel mold remediation, while giving interim trigger-reduction steps she can control.
